hero.title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Chapter I — NOW STREAMING on Crunchyroll
hero.date: Available on Crunchyroll since Mon Jul 28, 2026 — Japanese audio + English subs AND the English theatrical dub. Also purchasable ($19.99) / rentable ($14.99) on Prime Video and Apple TV.
hero.about: The first of three theatrical films continuing the Mugen Train / Hashira Training arcs — Tanjiro and the Hashira are dragged into Muzan's dimension-warping Infinity Castle for the climactic confrontation. Widely called some of the best-animated action of the decade. Confirmed on Crunchyroll (US) per Anime News Network / Collider / Forbes coverage from Anime Expo 2026.
hero.why: Two hits at once: (1) direct continuation of a Loved-list favorite (Demon Slayer), and (2) it's been sitting on your Watchlist as 'HELD from last week' — now actually reachable on Crunchyroll without renting. Perfect Sci-Fi/Fantasy match with the world-building and big spectacle you gravitate to.

new_this_week.why: Comedy movie in your wheelhouse — Ansari's dry-observational humor + Keanu's earnest-weirdo range + a light fantasy premise. Reads as a genuine sit-and-enjoy Friday-night pick.
